quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Quartz electronic cloth, with its low dielectric loss and ultra-low expansion coefficient, is a preferred material for high-frequency / high-speed CCL; the company is vertically integrated from quartz sand, quartz rods and quartz electronic yarn to quartz electronic cloth. AI compute and data-center build-out drove fast growth in quartz cloth testing demand; the ultra-thin quartz electronic cloth is still in client-side testing and end-customer certification; quartz electronic cloth sales were RMB 153 million in H1 2026. The company has developed a group of global CCL customers and stable cooperation with well-known international downstream companies.

quarterly_data.signal: Its semiconductor fused quartz glass materials are certified by Tokyo Electron, Lam Research, Applied Materials and Hitachi High-Tech; subsidiary Shanghai Feilihua Shichuang's quartz parts are certified by AMEC and NAURA. In optical fiber it supplies support and handle rods and furnace core tubes to the main preform makers and formed a joint venture to build a high-purity precision quartz materials project for optical fiber (substrate tubes and sleeves).
